    Build query parameters for FBI CDE API requests

    Source: R/http.R
    cde_query.Rd

    Formats year values and assembles a named list of query parameters for CDE API endpoint calls.

    cde_query(from, to, type = NULL, four_digit_year = FALSE)

    Arguments

    from

    Character string or numeric with the start date/year. When `four_digit_year = FALSE` expects `"MM-YYYY"` format; when `TRUE` accepts `"YYYY"` or a 4-digit numeric.

    to

    Character string or numeric with the end date/year. Same format rules as `from`.

    type

    Optional character string with the query type (e.g. `"counts"`, `"rates"`, `"totals"`). Defaults to `NULL`.

    four_digit_year

    Logical; when `TRUE` formats years as 4-digit `YYYY` (used for police employment `pe` endpoints). When `FALSE` (default) formats as `MM-YYYY`.

    Value

    A named list of query parameters, e.g. `list(from = "01-2015", to = "12-2020", type = "counts")`.

    Examples

    cde_query("01-2015", "12-2020", type = "counts")
#> $from
#> [1] "01-2015"
#> 
#> $to
#> [1] "12-2020"
#> 
#> $type
#> [1] "counts"
#> 
cde_query(2015, 2020, four_digit_year = TRUE)
#> $from
#> [1] "2015"
#> 
#> $to
#> [1] "2020"
#>
